basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Management Ranchi (IIM Ranchi) Assistant Manager, Academic Associate and More Posts Recruitment 2026 Notification has been released on 28 July 2026 on the official website of IIM Ranchi. A total of 6 vacancies have been announced through the IIM Ranchi Assistant Manager, Academic Associate and More Posts Recruitment 2026.

content_sections.heading: IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Corporate Relation Manager: MBA or equivalent with 55% marks and minimum 6 years of experience in placement services, career services, B2B sales, business development, or corporate relations. Assistant Manager (for Corporate Relations Office): MBA or equivalent with 55% marks and minimum 3 years of experience in placement services, career services, B2B sales, business development, or corporate relations. Academic Associate: Graduation or equivalent (55% marks) with 01 year relevant experience or MBA with 55% marks.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIM Ranchi Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 19-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Ranchi to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the IIM Ranchi Various Contract Positions is 19th August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Various Contract Positions at IIM Ranchi?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for Various Contract Positions at IIM Ranchi through this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official website of IIM Ranchi.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum qualification required for the Administrative Associate post?
faq.answer: For the Administrative Associate position, candidates need to have a Post Graduation or equivalent (55% marks) or B.Tech/BE (CS/ECE/IT) with 55% marks and 02 years of relevant work experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the notification, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Academic Associate post?
faq.answer: The Academic Associate post offers a consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these contract positions?
faq.answer: The selection process for these contract positions at IIM Ranchi will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article for easy access.

faq.question: Q9. What is the start date for the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process for the IIM Ranchi Recruitment 2026 begins on 30th July 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Does IIM Ranchi offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, IIM Ranchi offers age relaxation as per the Government of India rules for SC/ST/OBC/PwD/Ex-Servicemen candidates.
